notes: Brief S3, the large diamond vessels, made for the offer popup's tiles: the six packs' containers (the bag, the small chest, the brass-bound chest, the iron chest, the great chest, the royal chest) painted large on the flat navy ground (7,19,28) and keyed off it. Each is cut 8 px round its ink (distance > 40 from the ground) and drawn down to 120 tall, the popup tile's picture height -- never drawn up.

Named by the pack each is painted for (store/vessel_<diamonds>): a diamonds line in an offer wears the vessel of the largest pack it holds at least as many diamonds as (client/layout/offer_popup.json diamond_vessels).
